person: Nadia Haddad is a 50-year-old part-time bookkeeper with a chronic spine condition who can only sit at a screen for about twenty minutes at a time. This year she had an MRI, an outpatient spinal injection and some physical therapy, and the bills have come in from three places that don't seem to agree with her insurer's statements. She is also gathering records for a second opinion in three weeks, so she wants this chore done in short, stoppable sessions. She is careful with numbers, since she keeps books for a living, but she has little patience for portals and does not want to pay anything that might be wrong.
stated_up_front: I have about fifteen minutes today. Please check my medical bills against what Aetna says I owe, and tell me the one thing you need from me first.

facts.truth: Aetna PPO through her own small-business policy, with a $1,800 individual deductible that she met in May.
Aetna denied her lumbar MRI on June 2 as 'not medically necessary'. Her appeal window may be closing, and she has not appealed yet.
Valley Medical's MyChart shows $2,140 for the outpatient spinal injection on August 12. The Aetna EOB says she owes $480.
An anesthesia group bill for $615 for the same August 12 procedure appears on Cedar, but the EOB for it still says 'pending'.
In October she got a reminder from VMC Physicians Group for $2,140, which she thinks is the same hospital balance under another name.
She went to 11 physical therapy visits at Lakeview Physical Therapy between March and May. These are the visits that show the MRI was needed.
She paid $150 by card in July toward the hospital's radiology bill, and Aetna later reduced her share to $90, so she is owed $60 back.
She has an HSA and would want any refund sent there.
She can do about fifteen minutes at a time, and her second-opinion appointment is in three weeks.
She has logins for Aetna and MyChart. She signs in to Cedar with her email and a code texted to her phone.

unknowns: Whether the 180-day appeal window on her June 2 MRI denial has already closed or when exactly it closes
Whether VMC Physicians Group is the same billing as Valley Medical or a separate charge
Why the anesthesia EOB is still pending and when it will be decided
Whether the surprise-billing rules cover the anesthesia bill, since she does not know if that group is in her network
